name: Poisonous Swinging Spear Trap (CR 4)
body:
Poisonous Swinging Spear Trap

CR 4

XP 1,200

Type mechanical; Perception DC 25; Disable Device DC 20

EFFECTS

Trigger location; Reset manual

Effect +15 melee (1d6+6 plus small centipede poison)

A bamboo spear tipped with venom extracted from a monstrous centipede swings through the trees from the end of a hanging vine.
